posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Sorry, I misspoke - it's not saying the type is missing, it's saying the action doesn't have timed attack data attached to it at all.
Looks like you'd have to edit line 535 to start with
Code:
if(this._action.item().meta["SRD TAS"] && this._action.item().meta["SRD TAS"].type === "actor"
Then similarly on 544
Code:
} else if(this._action.item().meta["SRD TAS"] && this._action.item().meta["SRD TAS"].type === "class"
and line 553
Code:
} else if(this._action.item().meta["SRD TAS"] && this._action.item().meta["SRD TAS"].type === "weapon"

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Looks like you did not edit the lines correctly, causing a syntax error in the code so the plugin isn't being loaded at all.
Don't change anything after what I showed. So, for example, line 535
starts with
Code:
if(this._action.item().meta["SRD TAS"].type === "actor"
and you would change that to
Code:
if(this._action.item().meta["SRD TAS"] && this._action.item().meta["SRD TAS"].type === "actor"
and not change anything else on the rest of the line.
